title: GDELT sanctions share -> short TUR 7d
hypothesis: R2 | [risk-macro-em] GDELT GKG sanctions-share 20d z-score > 1 leads Turkey ETF returns lower by 5-7 days (-) via secondary-sanctions risk; trade short TUR 7d [gdelt.gkg.sanctions_share -> finance.TUR.log_return] (parent: R2-0086)
message: Not supported: sanctions-share z>1 vs TUR r=0.03 (n=390), best lag -4d r=0.11; short TUR 1d rule loses (hit 43%, avg -0.21%/trade, 42 trades, OOS -0.19%). Null.

trade_idea.entry_rule: gdelt.gkg.sanctions_share rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> short TUR next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 1 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.

followup_hypothesis: R2 | [risk-macro-em] GDELT GKG sanctions-share 20d z-score > 1 leads broad EM ETF returns higher by 3-5 days (+) as sanctions headlines mean-revert; trade long EEM 5d [gdelt.gkg.sanctions_share -> finance.EEM.log_return] (parent: R2-0189)
